text:
Nina (partnerships): Heads-up: upcoming partner SDK change — we plan to rename `auth_token` -> `api_key` in v4. It's small but breaking for some partners. Need rollout plan.

Tom (sdk): Breaking rename noted. We can add a compat flag `REDWOOD_SDK_DEPRECATE_AUTH_TOKEN=false` for a 30d grace. Will ship shim layer that maps old param.

Priya (eng): Gating: run canary with two marketplace partners, monitor auth failures and onboarding tickets. If auth failure rate >0.2% above baseline, rollback.

Marco (partner): Our integrator has hardcoded `auth_token` strings in templates. 30d is tight; can we provide a signed shim artifact they can pin?

Tom (sdk): Yes — will publish `redwood-sdk-v4-compat-auth` artifact and sign it. Also add migration snippet in README.

Nina (partnerships): I'll draft partner email and update marketplace docs. Please include exact env var + example config.

Tom (sdk): Env var example: `export REDWOOD_SDK_DEPRECATE_AUTH_TOKEN=false` plus code sample: `client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv("AUTH_TOKEN") if os.getenv("REDWOOD_SDK_DEPRECATE_AUTH_TOKEN") == "false" else os.getenv("API_KEY"))`.

deploy-bot: Canary release created: v4.0.0-canary-auth-2026-03-10. Metrics dashboard link: https://dash.redwood/canary/1740123456

Marco (partner): Thanks — we'll try canary and report within first 48h. Please whitelist our org for extended compat if needed.

Priya (eng): Noted. We'll keep a fast rollback path. Nina, send partner notice today.

Nina (partnerships): Draft ready, sending now. Thread will track canary results.
